Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Agentic systems and coding/development tool integrations: designed for complex multi-step, long-horizon agentic tasks, with broad support for popular harnesses and development tools; deployable via inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TokenSpeed) and text-only chat completions.
quotes: Beyond answering harder questions, Qwen3.8 is designed to carry complex, multi-step tasks through to completion with greater reliability.
**Downstream Compatibility**: Broader support for popular harnesses and development tools, making it easier to integrate into your existing stack.
**Agent Execution**: Stronger autonomous planning and better handling of environment feedback, leading to more reliable end-to-end task completion.
These artifacts are compatible with vLLM, SGLang, TokenSpeed, etc.
